approach_1_reference.name: Closed-Form Date Modifiers
approach_1_reference.technique: Direct date arithmetic using SQLite 'weekday N' modifier
approach_1_reference.memory_overhead: O(1) auxiliary space (no intermediate row generation)

approach_2_alternative.name: Recursive Calendar Expansion
approach_2_alternative.technique: Generates complete monthly calendar via recursive CTE, maps weekdays, and filters via window functions
approach_2_alternative.memory_overhead: Intermediate table of 28-31 rows generated per record
approach_2_alternative.portability: Standard SQL recursive CTE and window functions
